info.title: World crop cultivation
info.description: Owned, unlocked, paid bed and membership required. Dig before each sow. Seeds and initial water come from the backpack. Water is due at water_due_at and on time strictly before water_deadline_at. Missing any watering window halves yield once (integer floor, minimum one item), with existing health efficiency applied. Growth does not pause or shift. Harvest is permitted from ready_at until strictly before expires_at. Expired crops grant nothing and must be cleared using cancel. Cancel refunds no resources. Preview may report missing materials or output fits=false; execution rejects atomically. GET projects elapsed time without writes. Commands require preview, revisions and an idempotency key.

get.description: Crop id in this response identifies a crop revision. Select it as crop_revision_id for sowing. No crop content is automatically published.

get.summary: Private state of an owned, unlocked bed
get.description: No writes or timer jobs. Growth pauses at water_due_at if it is earlier than ready_at. ready_at is the stored baseline until overdue watering extends it. A ripe crop does not spoil while inventory is full.
